notes.title: Update : Menu UI, bug fix, lighting changed
notes.notes:
- Now the in-game menu can be called with the menu button on the left controller.

- The menu has only two functions : teleport the stage and quit the game.

- Fixed an issue where the light moved up when go to the next stage.

- Map lighting has changed. Stage 2 has a better view now, and stages 1, 3, and 4 have been darkened.

notes.title: Update : Bug fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue where some achievements were not being achieved.

- Fixed an issue when pressing the Teleport button before getting on the train.

- Fixed an issue where movement was restricted after teleporting on stages 2 and 3.


If you have any other problems, please contact us through the Steam Community.

notes.title: Update : Achievements
notes.notes:
Six types, a total of 15 challenges, became possible.
The updated achievements are as follows.

- Clear the game from start to end (without any conditions)

- Hit head shot continuously

- Kill the boss under certain conditions

- Kill the boss with using only SMG or rifle after getting on the train

- No die from start to end

- No hit from start to end

notes.title: Update : UI and features have been changed or added.
notes.notes:
- Oculus tutorial UI applied.

- Boss monster's melee attack range is now visible.

- Now rifle skill needs cost to use.

- Fixed a bug where SMG skill marks remained on dead enemies.

- Fixed an issue with timeouts in the tutorial area.

- Fixed an error starting in Stage 3 when dying after going directly to the boss battle without selecting a stage

- Fixed a bug that did not count timeout as death that displayed on game result area.

- The function removed that cancels the skill when SMG leaves the screen while using the SMG skill.

- Changed to create / disengage cobweb-like obstructions naturally.

notes.title: Update : Convenience improvements added
notes.notes:
- UI design changed

- Hand pitch adjustmenting UI added

- Oculus touch controller key mapping optimized

- 14 achievements are in testing... There is a problem that is currently not being achieved.
